description: Finite inventory rows fixture for integration workflow cases 1..20 (titles follow issue #915 required test matrix). Deterministic, no secrets, no live payloads.

rows.title: manual workflow_dispatch is the sole trigger
automatic triggers are rejected
manual inputs are closed (none or fixed profile enum)
source checkout binds SHA identities with fetch-depth 0
effective permissions are read-only with persist-credentials false
every third-party action is pinned to an immutable full SHA
no credentials flow to child steps; fixed artifact channel only
windows-latest runner with explicit gaps and no silent skips
pinned toolchain with locked build
ignored-test inventory is built before configuration and run
only required providers activate within the closed 9-op set
ValidateConfiguration runs before exactly one Run
build is delegated to the owned build entry point
bounded concurrency with per-job timeouts
cache hit executes the same gates as cache miss
always() cleanup collects evidence; unknown stays non-green
manifest and digest mismatch is non-green
bounded retention with redacted summaries
source guard rejects foreign or mismatched sources
live evidence is SHA-bound to the dispatched commit via controller post-merge dispatch
